meaning: 与外界有更多联系/接触
usageNote: 日常短语，说人或地方不要太封闭、多出去见见世面，语气温和建议感，不强硬！

examples.en: Living abroad helped me have more contact with the outside world.
examples.zh: 在国外生活让我与外界有了更多接触。

examples.en: The school encourages students to have more contact with the outside world through internships.
examples.zh: 学校鼓励学生通过实习与外界建立更多联系。
